name: NLGraph
description: NLGraph is a comprehensive benchmark of graph-based problem solving designed in natural language, covering 29,370 problems across eight graph reasoning tasks of varying complexity from simple connectivity to complex maximum flow and graph neural network simulation.
reputation: A substantial synthetic graph-reasoning benchmark that has seen use in graph and reasoning research, though it is not as universally adopted as classic NLP benchmarks.
notes: Benchmark includes eight graph reasoning tasks; proposes prompting methods to improve LLM performance; benchmark and code available on GitHub.
